svg.metadata: 写一句 — Liu Jian Mao Cao (流江毛草), https://github.com/googlefonts/liujianmaocao . 拍照、选图、录音、清单 — Zhi Mang Xing (志莽行书), https://github.com/googlefonts/zhimangxing . Glyph outlines from the Google Fonts distributions.
